Dear Madam
I am exceedingly sorry for this, but I have nothing to do with those advertisements which are entirely [the publisher](/person/744)’s affair [^1] I will send him your letter at once

yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: CMY\'s correspondent had evidently complained about the advertisement in MP of a book by [Mary Ward](/person/1467), whose Robert Elsmere was a novel about a clergyman\'s loss of faith.

See below, letter to Innes (1 November 1888).
